title: Atahualpa becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Atawallpa, also Atahualpa or Ataw Wallpa, whose regnal name was Caccha Pachacuti Inca Yupanqui Inca, was the last effective Inca emperor, reigning from April 1532 until his capture and execution in July of the following year, as part of the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire.

title: Pachacútec becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Pachacuti Inca Yupanqui, also called Pachacútec, was the ninth Sapa Inca of the Chiefdom of Cusco, which he transformed into the Inca Empire.

title: Huayna Capac becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Huayna Capac was the eleventh Sapa Inca of Tawantinsuyu, the Inca Empire.

title: Huascar becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Huáscar also Guazcar was Sapa Inca of the Inca Empire from 1527 to 1532.

title: Manco Capac becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Manco Cápac, also known as Manco Inca and Ayar Manco, was, according to some historians, the first governor and founder of the Inca civilisation in Cusco, possibly in the early 13th century.

title: Túpac Inca Yupanqui becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Topa Inca Yupanqui or Túpac Inca Yupanqui, also Topa Inga Yupangui, erroneously translated as "noble Inca accountant" was the tenth Sapa Inca (1471–1493) of the Inca Empire, fifth of the Hanan dynasty.

title: Wiracocha Inca becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Viracocha Inca or Viracocha was the eighth Sapa Inka of the Kingdom of Cuzco and the third of the Hanan dynasty.

title: Inca Roca becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Inca Roca was the sixth Sapa Inca of the Kingdom of Cusco and the first of the Hanan ("upper") Qusqu dynasty.

title: Yáhuar Huácac becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Yawar Waqaq or Yawar Waqaq Inka was the seventh Sapa Inca of the Kingdom of Cusco and the second of the Hanan dynasty.

title: Sinchi Roca becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Sinchi Roca, also known as Sinchi Rocca, Cinchi Roca, Sinchi Ruq'a and Sinchi Ruq'a Inka, was the second Sapa Inca of the Kingdom of Cusco and a member of the Hurin dynasty.

title: Cápac Yupanqui becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Cápac Yupanqui was the fifth Sapa Inca of the Kingdom of Cusco and the last of the Hurin dynasty.

title: Lloque Yupanqui becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Lloque Yupanqui was the third Sapa Inca of the Kingdom of Cuzco and a member of the Hurin dynasty.

title: Mayta Cápac becomes Sapa Inca
fact: Mayta Cápac was the fourth Sapa Inca of the Kingdom of Cuzco and a member of the Hurin dynasty.
